about: PU-303, the gas-turbine unit's control panel (ПУЛЬТ УПРАВЛЕНИЯ ТИП ПУ303), from the book's drawing of it with every control labelled (wwp_gecko g084-d, laid flat as 'pu303') and checked against the photograph g084-b: every part picked by its number on the flat and written into data/cabins/osa_ak.json by tools/recon/osa/panel_apply.py. Millimetres from the plate's centre, u right, v up.

panels.notes: PU-303 (ПУЛЬТ УПРАВЛЕНИЯ ТИП ПУ303), the gas-turbine power unit's control panel at the driver's left (voenizdat_osa_1991 p163; mon_2112_80 Fig. 3), as the book draws it with every control labelled (wwp_gecko g084-d) and photographs it (g084-b): the ГТА's rpm and gas temperature (ТВГ) gauges, the turbine's intake and exhaust hatches ЛЮКИ ОТКР./ЗАКР., СТОП, ХОЛ. ПРОКР. and ПУСК, the loads ГТА, ГОМ and ИВП switched on and ОТКЛ. НАГР., their lamps, the lamp test, the two generators' voltage adjusters and hour counters. 300 mm wide (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3's plan, good to 10 mm), 364 mm tall as drawn; a black plate. Its place and tilt: SAM3D's estimate.

new.label: ПИТАНИЕ УПРАВЛЕНИЯ (control power)
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d (PU-303 drawn with its labels: the switch ПИТАНИЕ УПРАВЛЕНИЯ, ОТКЛ. — ВКЛ.), g084-b
new.notes: Powers PU-303's controls. Not modelled: the ГТА starts on ПУСК alone in the sim.

new.label: ПИТАНИЕ УПРАВЛЕНИЯ
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d, g084-b (a lamp beside the switch ПИТАНИЕ УПРАВЛЕНИЯ, green in the photo); when it lights: sam3d
new.notes: Lit while PU-303's controls are powered.

new.label: ПОДСВЕТКА (the panel's lights)
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d (PU-303: the switch ПОДСВЕТКА, ОТКЛ. — ВКЛ., between the two dome lights), g084-b

new.label: ЛЮКИ ОТКР. (the turbine's hatches open)
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d (PU-303: the push-buttons ЛЮКИ ОТКР. and ЗАКР., a lamp over each), g084-b
new.notes: The gas turbine's intake and exhaust hatches, as read from the panel (SAM3D's reading). Not modelled: nothing reads it.

new.label: ЛЮКИ ЗАКР. (the turbine's hatches closed)
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d (PU-303: the push-button ЛЮКИ ЗАКР.), g084-b

new.label: КОНТР. ЛАМП (lamp test)
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d (PU-303: a pointer switch КОНТР. ЛАМП, ОТКЛ. — ВКЛ.), g084-b
new.notes: Not modelled: it lights no lamp in the sim.

new.label: СТОП (the turbine stopped)
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d (PU-303: the red push-button СТОП), g084-b
new.notes: Not modelled: ПУСК (pwr.gta) starts and stops the ГТА in the sim.

new.label: ХОЛ. ПРОКР. (cold cranking)
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d (PU-303: the push-button ХОЛ. ПРОКР. between СТОП and ПУСК), g084-b
new.notes: Turns the turbine over without lighting it. Not modelled: nothing reads it.

items.why: the console's on/off for the ГТА drawn as PU-303's ПУСК (wwp_gecko g084-d): pressed in while the unit runs

items.what: the lamp over ВКЛЮЧЕНИЕ НАГРУЗОК ГТА
the lamp over ВКЛЮЧЕНИЕ НАГРУЗОК ГОМ
the lamp over ВКЛЮЧЕНИЕ НАГРУЗОК ИВП

new.label: ВКЛЮЧЕНИЕ НАГРУЗОК: ГТА (the loads on the turbine's generator)
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d (PU-303: under ВКЛЮЧЕНИЕ НАГРУЗОК the push-buttons ГТА, ГОМ and ИВП), g084-b
new.notes: Not modelled: ПУСК (pwr.gta) puts the ГТА on line in the sim.

items.why: the console's power take-off generator drawn as PU-303's ВКЛЮЧЕНИЕ НАГРУЗОК ГОМ (wwp_gecko g084-d; ГОМ, генератор отбора мощности): pressed in while on

new.label: ВКЛЮЧЕНИЕ НАГРУЗОК: ИВП
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d (PU-303: the third of the load push-buttons, ИВП), g084-b
new.notes: ИВП's meaning is not known (a secondary power source?). Not modelled: nothing reads it.

new.label: ОТКЛ. НАГР. (loads off)
new.source: wwp_gecko g084-d (PU-303: the red push-button ОТКЛ. НАГР.), g084-b

items.label: НАПР. ГОМ
